== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine), cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 4 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of January 1, 2013” (PDF made 16 April 2013): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[R4-M9 (Arfour-Emmnine) (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/20/Premiere-D-r4m9-PC-Errata-2013-slip.png Internet Archive item].
